beats.narration_text: Liam, in for Bear — part four. Physics: trail echo with low-opacity copies chasing a fast slide, noise wobble on sine-driven micro-jitter that settles to stillness, elastic physics with scale-Y squash and rebound, and orbit parts — the two paths that make the H split, orbit each other, and rejoin. That last one is unique to this mark.

Your turn. Paste this: split the two paths of the H logo, orbit them around each other on a spring, then rejoin them into the mark — and tell me whether the orbit reads as playful or as structural. The H is two structures. That's the move.
H logo, in motion. Part four. Liam, in for Bear.
